India Launches Campaign for UN Security Council Seat

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar has initiated India's campaign for a non-permanent seat on the UN Security Council for the 2028-29 term. The campaign launch occurred during his visit to the US, with elections for the seat scheduled for June 2027. This move signifies India's ongoing efforts to secure a more prominent role in international security discussions.
